name: Build Hooks for Netlify
description: Supports creating frontend environments connected to Netlify.
ecosystem_note: Submodule of build_hooks. Adds one FrontendEnvironment plugin ('netlify'). Triggering a deploy simply POSTs (no auth) to the per-environment Netlify build-hook URL — the build-hook URL is itself the secret. Separately, a site-wide Netlify personal access token (build_hooks_netlify.settings.netlify_api_key) + the environment's api_id are used ONLY to fetch and display the recent-deploys table on the deploy form, via Netlify API (GET /sites/{api_id}/deploys?access_token=...); the token is placed in the URL query string. NetlifyManager service. Secrets: token plaintext in config, rendered into the settings form textfield, and passed in the list-deploys URL — see security.md.
